observation.command:
cat > /tmp/build_rsq.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
SVC=rechtsquellenvorbereitung
CTX=/tmp/g_$SVC
rm -rf "$CTX"; mkdir -p "$CTX"
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/$SVC/. "$CTX"/
rm -rf "$CTX/.git"
cp -r /workspace/03-shared-services "$CTX/03-shared-services"
# sibling tatbestand: ../tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction -> place under 02-backend/tatbestands... to keep relative
mkdir -p "$CTX/02-backend"
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction "$CTX/tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction"
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./\.\./03-shared-services/|path = "03-shared-services/|g' "$CTX/pyproject.toml"
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction"|path = "tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction"|g' "$CTX/pyproject.toml"
awk '{print} /^WORKDIR \/app[[:space:]]*$/ {print "COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/\nCOPY tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction/ ./tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction/"}' "$CTX/Dockerfile" > "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" && mv "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" "$CTX/Dockerfile"
cd "$CTX"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f uv.lock
uv lock >/tmp/lock_rsq.log 2>&1 || { echo LOCKFAIL; tail -8 /tmp/lock_rsq.log; exit 3; }
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 timeout 590 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN -t rechtsquellenvorbereitung .
SH
chmod +x /tmp/build_rsq.sh
/tmp/build_rsq.sh > /tmp/build_rsq2.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -6 /tmp/build_rsq2.log
